# zapleo — Dmitriy Zaporozhets

Dmitriy Zaporozhets is a Ukrainian business operator and AI integrator based in Nha Trang, Vietnam. He founded Zapleo, led an IT STEP Academy branch in Jakarta from April to August 2026, and built AI systems alongside that work. He does not represent himself as a traditional programmer; he designs and delivers systems with AI-assisted development and human review.

## Current service

Revenue Recovery Sprint: a fixed-scope, ten-business-day diagnostic of one inbound sales funnel. It traces leads from source through CRM, calls, messages and handoffs. Deliverables: measured loss map, opportunity model with stated assumptions, and a first-fix implementation blueprint. Fee: US$5,000, split between start and deliverable review. Full production integration and guaranteed revenue are outside this sprint.

Service page: https://zapleo.com/revenue-recovery/
Contact: dima@zapleo.com

## Selected work

- Stepan: AI sales conversations connected to messaging and CRM, with human handoff and checks on claims. https://stepan2.zapleo.com/
- AIbroker: model gateway for routing, cost tracking and provider control. https://zapleo.com/work/aibroker/
- Vera: personal memory system integrating communications into a searchable store. https://github.com/zapleoceo/muai
- Veranda: hospitality operation in Nha Trang, Vietnam.

Past-project figures are not future-performance promises. The site should not be read as a guarantee of extra sales or a statement that Dmitriy is still director of IT STEP Jakarta.
